Our rating

The 2017 Nissan Rogue SL Platinum is a well-rounded compact SUV that offers a comfortable ride, an attractive interior, and a host of safety features. Its performance is adequate for daily commuting, and it excels in terms of value and space. However, its tech features and fuel efficiency are average, keeping it from scoring higher.
